faq.q: What is the cheapest yacht for a stag weekend in Marbella?
faq.a: The cheapest option is the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (both 12.5m) at €749 for 2 hours. For a full day (8 hours), it's €2,299. Both hold up to 11 passengers and include a skipper, drinks, and snacks.

faq.q: How much does a Mangusta 80 cost for a stag party?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. This includes a free jet ski, licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Great for a luxury stag experience with up to 12 guests.

faq.q: What is included in the yacht charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs – just show up.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks on board?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The included bar covers basics, but many stag groups bring extra beer, spirits, or a BBQ. Just check with us beforehand for space.

faq.q: How many people can fit on a stag yacht?
faq.a: Capacity ranges from 5 pax on the Dubhe (8m) up to 12 pax on most large yachts like the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, or Ferretti 94. For larger groups, we can arrange multiple boats or a catamaran like the Lagoon 380 (10 pax).

faq.q: What is the best time of year for a stag yacht in Marbella?
faq.a: May to October offers the best weather – 25-30°C, calm seas, and long days. July and August are peak season, so book early. April and November can also work but expect cooler breezes.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht for a stag weekend?
faq.a: Simply contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on boats not listed with fixed rates. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly online. All bookings require a deposit.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on our charter day?
faq.a: We monitor conditions closely. If the forecast is unsafe, we'll reschedule or offer a full refund. In most cases, we can adjust the route to sheltered areas like Cabopino or Estepona.

Planning a Marbella stag weekend yacht charter in 2026? You're probably wondering how much it costs, what's included, and which boat fits your group. This breakdown covers real prices, boat options, and hidden extras – so you can budget with confidence. Whether you're 5 or 12 lads, we've got the numbers.

Why a yacht is the ultimate stag activity

Forget paintball or go-karting – a day on the water in Puerto Banús is the real Marbella stag experience. You get privacy, a floating party base, and access to exclusive coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés. Plus, every charter includes a skipper, so no one has to stay sober. The Golden Mile skyline, the Mediterranean sun, and your mates – it's a memory maker.

Marbella stag weekend yacht budget breakdown: the numbers

Here's the honest cost split for 2026. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT – no surprises.

For a full Marbella stag weekend yacht budget breakdown, assume €749 for a short taster or €2,299 for an all-day session. Split between 9 guys, that's just €83 per person for 2 hours or €255 for 8 hours – cheaper than most club tables.

What you get for your money

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish VAT

No extra charges for cleaning, docking, or crew. Just bring your group, your music, and your sunglasses.

Which boat for your stag group size?

  • 5–6 lads: Speedboat (7m, €price on request) or Red Tide (11m, 6 pax). Intimate and fast.
  • 8–10 lads: Astondoa 40 (9 pax) or Azimut 39 (11 pax) – perfect balance of cost and comfort.
  • 10–12 lads: Mangusta 80 (12 pax) or any of the 24m+ yachts – serious style.

How to save money on your stag yacht

  • Book a Tier A boat (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) for the best per-person rate.
  • Choose a 4-hour charter instead of 8 – plenty of time for a swim, drinks, and a cruise past the Golden Mile.
  • Go mid-week (Mon–Thu) for lower demand – though all our prices are fixed.
  • Bring your own extra booze – the included bar covers basics, but you can top up with your favourites.
  • Share the cost: a group of 10 on an Azimut 39 for 8 hours is just €230 each.

What to expect on the day

You'll meet at Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's luxury scene. Board your yacht, meet the skipper, and head out. Typical itinerary: cruise past the Marbella Marina, stop for a swim at Cabopino or Cala del Faro, enjoy drinks and snacks, then return. For longer charters, you can go as far as Estepona or Sotogrande. The skipper knows the best spots for photos and fun.

Book your 2026 stag weekend now

2026 dates are filling fast, especially for May to October. To secure your preferred boat, contact us via WhatsApp with your date, group size, and preferred boat. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. Deposits required – balance due on the day. Don't leave it too late.
